ground_truth_used_for.classical_two_view: a single median depth ratio, to fix the unobservable monocular scale
ground_truth_used_for.self_supervised_monodepth: nothing at inference; used for evaluation and for optional median scaling
ground_truth_used_for.pointmap: nothing at inference; used for evaluation and for optional median scaling

classical_two_view.source: no focal estimate: the calibrated K is an input to this method

self_supervised_monodepth.source: no focal estimate: the calibrated K is an input to this method

classical_two_view_gap2.source: no focal estimate: the calibrated K is an input to this method

scale_analysis.note: Monocular geometry is recovered only up to scale. `scale_factor` is the per-frame median ratio gt/pred; `drift` is the std/mean of that factor across frames. `with_umeyama` additionally allows a 7-DoF similarity, which a depth-only method cannot exploit but a pointmap method can.
